chapter.verse: Festas Mangpa tua gamah a tun’ khit ni thum khit ciangin Kaisaria khua panin Jerusalem khua-ah a paito hi.
Tua lai takin siampi liante leh Judah miliante in Paul’ thu a ko uh hi.
Lampi-ah bukin thah ding a vaihawm uh a, Jerusalem khua-ah a paisak nadingin a thuum uh hi.
Ahih hangin Festas in zong, “Paul in Kaisaria khua-ah kikhumin a om hi. Tua khua-ah a sawt loin ka pai ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note lakah ahi theite in kei hong zui-in, tuapa tungah mawhna a om leh, na mawhsak ta un,” a ci hi.
Festas in amaute lakah ni giat bang, ni sawm bang a taam khit ciangin Kaisaria khua-ah pai a, a zing ciangin thukhen tokhom tungah tu-in Paul a samsak hi.
Paul a tun’ ciangin Jerusalem khua pan hong pai Judah mite in amah uumin, teci a lak zo lo, a lian mahmah mawhna tampi tawh Paul a mawhsak uh hi.
Paul in, “Keimah in Judah ngeina Thukham ahi zongin amau biakna innpi tungah ahi zongin, Kaisar Kumpipa tungah ahi zongin ka khial kei hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Festas in, “Jerusalem khua pai a, keimah in hih thu ka hong khensak ding na ut hiam?” ci-in Judah mite lungdamsak nuamin Paul kiangah a dong hi.
Paul in zong, “Kaisar Kumpipa’ thukhenna tokhom mai-ah ka ding hi, hih tokhom mai-ah kei’ thu nong khensak ding kilawm hi. Nang na theih bangin Judah mite tungah bangmah ka mawh kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin mi gilo ka hih a, sih nading a, kilawm mawhna ka hih leh, sihna tawh ka kipelh kei ding hi. Ahi zongin tua mite hong mawhsaknate khat beek a man kei leh kuamah in amaute khut tungah hong pia zo kei ding hi. Kaisar Kumpipa kiangah azu ka khan ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Festas Mangpa in upate tawh a vaihawm khit ciangin, “Nang in ‘Kaisar Kumpipa kiangah azu ka khan ding hi,’ na ci ahih ciangin, Kaisar Kumpipa kiangah na pai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tu nung a sawt loin, Agrippa Kumpipa in ama zi Bernike tawh Kaisar a tun’ ciangin Festas a hopih hi.
Sau veipi a om khit ciangin Festas Mangpipa in Paul’ thu kumpipa kiangah a gen-inah, “Feliks Mangpipa in thong sungah khumin a nutsiat mi khat a om hi.
Jerusalem khua-ah ka om lai takin siampi liante leh Judah upate in tuapa thu hong ko uh a, hong khensak in ci-in hong thuum uh ciangin,
keimah in zong, ‘Mawhsakna a thuak mi in a mawhsak mite tawh kimaituah sak a, a tungah a koih mawhna a phelna thu a gen khit matengin kuamah kiangah piak ding Rom ngeina ahi kei hi,’ ci-in ka gen hi.
Tua mite in hih san takah hong kikhop uh ciangin khawl loin, a zing ciangin thukhen tokhom tungah tu-in tuapa ka samsak hi.
Amaute a ding uh a, ama tungah ka upmawh bangin thusia a koih kei uh hi.
Amaute biakna thu leh a sisa mi khat ahi, Zeisu hangah kidongin a mawhsak uh hi. Paul in, ‘Tua Zeisu a nungta hi,’ a ci hi.
Tua thudotna ka theihtel loh lai takin, ‘Jerusalem khua-ah pai a, hih thu tanna na thuak ding hiam?’ ci-in amah ka dot leh,
a lian Kumpipa kiangah azukhan nuam a, amah a kikhum lai nading hong ngen ahih ciangin, Karsar Kumpipa kiangah ka paisak mateng dongin ka khumsak hi,” a ci hi.
Agrippa in zong, “Tua pa thu ka za nuam hi,” a cih ciangin, Festas in, “Zing ciangin ama thu na za ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin zingsang ciangin Agrippa leh Bernike in kithupi bawlna tawh khua sung uliante tawh hong tung uh a, kikhopna inn sungah a tum uh ciangin Festas in thu a piak ciangin Paul a lutsak uh hi.

Festas in, “Kumpipa Agrippa akipan kote tawh a omkhawm mite aw, hih pa na mu uh hi. Jerusalem khua leh hi lai-ah Judah mite khempeuh in ama thu kei hong ko uh a, ‘Amah in tomkha nangawn nungta ding a kilawm kei hi,’ hong ci uh hi.
Amah in sihna thuak ding akilawm mawhna ahih loh ka thei a, kumpi lianpa kiangah azukhan nuam ahih ciangin, a pai nading thu ka khensat hi.

Ama thu gelh a, Kumpipa kiangah piak ding thu a kitel tak khat beek ka nei kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin note in na dottel khit uh ciangin lai gelh ding ka neih nadingin nomau mai-ah ahi zongin, kumpipa Agrippa kiangah ahi zongin amah kong paipih zo hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a kikhumpa a kimawhsakna lai pia loin paisak leng akilawm kei hi ci-in ka um hi,” a ci hi.
